description: When the pandemic first hit, I knew that my industry would be one of the first to close and last to return because the arts, and the performing arts in particular, rely on audiences; live theater, though it can be captured onscreen, is simply not the same artform when it is not live.
title: Delegate Heather Bagnall - Keeping The Arts And Entertainment Afloat In A Pandemic — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
